partition: public-browse (anonymous visitor: home, categories, category/subcategory pages, resource detail, tag pages, search page + cmd-K palette, pagination/filters, breadcrumbs, sidebar counts)

findings.title: Search page SUBCATEGORY facet counts detach from their labels and overlap the result cards
reproSteps: Go to /search?q=ffmpeg (any query that returns results)
Observe the left 'Narrow results' rail: CATEGORY facet counts are right-aligned correctly inside the rail
Scroll the SUBCATEGORY facet section: its count numbers (e.g. 79, 13, 5) render far to the right at x=692, outside the rail, floating on top of the result cards near 'ffmpeg-static'/'View Details'
findings.expected: Subcategory facet counts stay right-aligned within the facet rail, like the category facet counts
findings.actual: Subcategory facet count spans (button uses flex/justify-between/w-full but overflows the rail width) land at x~692 overlapping the middle result-card column; measured span.text '79' at x=692,y=649 and '13' at x=692,y=693, parent BUTTON class 'flex min-h-11 w-full items-center justify-between'

findings.title: Invalid category/subcategory slugs show transient-looking 'Error Loading Resources / Please try again' with no navigation, instead of a proper 404 like resource pages
reproSteps: Visit /category/does-not-exist-xyz (HTTP 404) — page body shows 'Error Loading Resources / Please try again.' with no Home/Browse button
Visit /subcategory/does-not-exist-xyz — same 'Error Loading Resources / Please try again.'
Compare with /resource/99999999 (also 404) which shows a polished 'Page Not Found' card with 'Browse all categories' and 'Go Home' buttons
findings.expected: A non-existent category/subcategory should present the same clear 'Page Not Found' state (with navigation) as a non-existent resource; a transient 'Please try again' message wrongly implies a network glitch the user should retry
findings.actual: category/subcategory 404s render 'Error Loading Resources / Please try again' (errLoad=true, pleaseRetry=true, pageNotFound=false, hasGoHome=false) with no recovery affordance; resource 404 renders 'Page Not Found' + Go Home/Browse buttons

findings.title: Tag landing pages corrupt brand/acronym casing (FFmpeg -> FFMPEG, WebAssembly -> Webassembly) in both the visible H1 and the prerendered og:title
reproSteps: Visit /tag/FFmpeg -> H1 reads 'FFMPEG' (textTransform:none, so it is the real string), <title> 'FFMPEG Video Resources & Tools'
Visit /tag/WebAssembly -> H1 reads 'Webassembly', title 'Webassembly Video Resources & Tools'
curl -A Googlebot /tag/WebAssembly follows 301 to /tag/webassembly and its prerendered og:title is 'Webassembly Video Resources & Tools — Awesome Video'
findings.expected: Tag display should preserve the canonical tag casing: 'FFmpeg', 'WebAssembly'
findings.actual: Casing is normalized inconsistently (FFmpeg->all caps, WebAssembly->title case), losing correct brand capitalization; propagates into <title> and og:title seen by crawlers

findings.title: Multi-word tag pages produce awkward duplicated 'Video' in the title: 'Video Streaming Video Resources & Tools'
reproSteps: Visit /tag/video streaming
Observe document.title = 'Video Streaming Video Resources & Tools — Awesome Video'
findings.expected: Title template should avoid word repetition when the tag already contains 'Video' (e.g. 'Video Streaming Resources & Tools')
findings.actual: The fixed 'X Video Resources & Tools' template concatenates blindly, yielding 'Video Streaming Video Resources & Tools'

findings.title: Single-resource subcategory pages show incorrect plural: '1 resources available' and 'Showing 1-1 of 1 resources'
reproSteps: Visit /subcategory/online-forums (contains exactly 1 resource)
Header reads '1 resources available'; result count reads 'Showing 1-1 of 1 resources'
Note the 'About this collection' prose on the same page correctly says 'includes 1 curated resource' (singular) — inconsistent within the page
Repeat on /subcategory/software-codecs (also 1 resource) — same '1 resources'
findings.expected: Singular noun for a count of 1: '1 resource available', 'Showing 1-1 of 1 resource'
findings.actual: Header and 'Showing' labels always use plural 'resources' regardless of count; only the About paragraph pluralizes correctly

findings.title: Public /api/awesome-list tree is stale/incomplete: 1,461 resources vs 1,816 shown everywhere else on the site (missing ~355 resources and whole subcategories)
reproSteps: GET /api/awesome-list and sum resources across the tree -> 1461
GET /api/resources?limit=1 -> total 1816; home/category cards/sidebar all show 1,816
Per-category the tree undercounts vs the site: encoding-codecs tree=266 vs UI 333; players-clients tree=152 vs UI 239; protocols-transport tree=110 vs UI 213
Subcategories present in the live UI (e.g. Online Forums under Community Groups, 1 resource) are entirely absent from the /api/awesome-list tree
findings.expected: The public cached tree API should reflect the same approved catalog the UI shows (1,816 resources, all subcategories/sub-subcategories)
findings.actual: Tree returns 1,461 resources, undercounts every category, and omits multiple subcategories/sub-subcategories that exist and render in the UI; site-map states the tree 'carries real numeric DB ids usable for navigation', so consumers relying on it get an incomplete catalog

findings.title: Provider/Format/Skill-level filters are inert: every resource is 'Not yet classified', so each facet offers a single useless option and the resource prose repeats the filler 3x
reproSteps: Open any category page (e.g. /category/encoding-codecs): PROVIDER 'Not yet classified' 333, FORMAT 'Not yet classified' 333, SKILL LEVEL 'Not yet classified' 333 — the only option in each facet
Confirm globally: /api/awesome-list shows resourceFormat/provider/skillLevel = 'unknown' for all 1,461 tree resources; /api/resources/184792 also 'unknown' for all three

Open any resource detail (e.g. /resource/186391): Provider/Format/Skill level all 'Not yet classified' AND the auto-generated paragraph reads 'Provider: Not yet classified. Format: Not yet classified. Skill level: Not yet classified.'
findings.expected: Filters added for provider/format/skill should offer meaningful choices; if 100% of the catalog is unclassified, these facets should be hidden and the filler should not be surfaced 3x in human-readable prose
findings.actual: All three facets contain only 'Not yet classified' (equal to total), so filtering does nothing; the resource SEO/description paragraph repeats 'Not yet classified' three times on every resource

findings.title: Case-variant tag URLs both resolve to the same page (/tag/FFmpeg and /tag/ffmpeg render identical content), plus 301 lowercasing only fires for mixed-case via crawler path
reproSteps: In-app SPA navigation to /tag/FFmpeg renders H1 'FFMPEG', 78 results
SPA navigation to /tag/ffmpeg renders the identical page (H1 'FFMPEG', 78 results) — two client URLs, same content
curl -A Googlebot /tag/WebAssembly returns 301 -> /tag/webassembly (server canonicalizes for crawlers), but the SPA itself keeps whichever mixed-case path the user landed on
findings.expected: One canonical tag URL; client should also normalize/redirect mixed-case tag paths to the canonical lowercase to avoid duplicate landing pages
findings.actual: Both /tag/FFmpeg and /tag/ffmpeg serve full identical pages client-side (duplicate landing surfaces); canonicalization only happens on the server 301 path
